name: Femboy Futa Dorm
source: One cheap room, five irresistible housemates, and a charter nobody agrees on. Femboy Futa Dorm is an adult romantic visual novel set in Lavender Hall, a residence famous for its femboy and futanari residents, absurd traditions, and late-night confessions.
translation: 一间廉价卧室、五位令人难以抗拒的室友，外加一份谁也无法达成共识的住宿公约。《伪娘扶他宿舍》（Femboy Futa Dorm）是一款成人恋爱视觉小说，故事发生在以伪娘与扶他住客、荒诞传统以及深夜告白而闻名的“薰衣草公寓”之中。
